name: Shortest Path to Domain Admin
description: Find the shortest attack path from any owned principal to the Domain Admin group
cypher: MATCH (n {owned:true}), (target:Group {name:'DOMAIN ADMINS@{domain}'}), p=shortestPath((n)-[*1..15]->(target)) WHERE n<>target RETURN p

name: All Paths to Domain Admin
description: Enumerate all paths (not just shortest) to Domain Admin
cypher: MATCH (n {owned:true}), (target:Group {name:'DOMAIN ADMINS@{domain}'}), p=allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..10]->(target)) WHERE n<>target RETURN p

name: Kerberoastable Users
description: Find all users with SPNs set (Kerberoastable) - targets for offline hash cracking
cypher: MATCH (u:ADUser {hasspn:true}) WHERE u.enabled=true RETURN u.name AS user, u.displayname AS display_name, u.description AS description, u.serviceprincipalnames AS spns, u.pwdlastset AS pwd_last_set ORDER BY u.name

name: AS-REP Roastable Users
description: Find users with Kerberos pre-authentication disabled (AS-REP Roastable)
cypher: MATCH (u:ADUser {dontreqpreauth:true}) WHERE u.enabled=true RETURN u.name AS user, u.displayname AS display_name, u.description AS description, u.pwdlastset AS pwd_last_set ORDER BY u.name

name: Users with DCSync Rights
description: Find principals with DCSync rights (DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All permission)
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:DCSync|AllExtendedRights|GenericAll]->(d:ADDomain) RETURN n.name AS principal, labels(n) AS type, d.name AS domain ORDER BY n.name

name: Unconstrained Delegation
description: Find computers/users with unconstrained delegation enabled
cypher: MATCH (n {unconstraineddelegation:true}) WHERE NOT n:ADDomain RETURN n.name AS name, labels(n) AS type, n.operatingsystem AS os, n.enabled AS enabled ORDER BY n.name

name: Constrained Delegation
description: Find principals with constrained delegation configured
cypher: MATCH (n {constraineddelegation:true}) RETURN n.name AS name, labels(n) AS type, n.allowedtodelegate AS allowed_to_delegate ORDER BY n.name

name: High Value Targets
description: List all high-value targets (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, etc.)
cypher: MATCH (n {highvalue:true}) RETURN n.name AS name, labels(n) AS type, n.description AS description ORDER BY labels(n)[0], n.name

name: GPO Abuse Paths
description: Find principals that can modify GPOs linked to high-value targets
cypher: MATCH (n)-[r:GenericWrite|GenericAll|WriteDACL|WriteOwner]->(g:ADGPO) WITH n, g MATCH (g)-[r2:GpLink]->(target {highvalue:true}) RETURN n.name AS attacker, g.name AS gpo, target.name AS affected_target ORDER BY n.name

name: GenericAll Permissions
description: Find all GenericAll ACL relationships (full control over another object)
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:GenericAll]->(m) WHERE n<>m RETURN n.name AS source, labels(n) AS source_type, m.name AS target, labels(m) AS target_type ORDER BY n.name

name: WriteDACL Permissions
description: Find principals that can modify DACLs on other objects
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:WriteDACL]->(m) WHERE n<>m RETURN n.name AS source, labels(n) AS source_type, m.name AS target, labels(m) AS target_type ORDER BY n.name

name: ForceChangePassword Permissions
description: Find who can force-change another user's password without knowing the current one
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:ForceChangePassword]->(m:ADUser) RETURN n.name AS attacker, labels(n) AS attacker_type, m.name AS victim, m.enabled AS victim_enabled ORDER BY m.name

name: AdminTo Relationships
description: Find all local administrator relationships across hosts
cypher: MATCH (u)-[:AdminTo]->(c:ADComputer) RETURN u.name AS admin, labels(u) AS admin_type, c.name AS computer, c.operatingsystem AS os ORDER BY c.name

name: Active Sessions
description: Find active user sessions on remote computers
cypher: MATCH (u:ADUser)-[:HasSession]->(c:ADComputer) RETURN u.name AS user, c.name AS computer, c.operatingsystem AS os ORDER BY c.name

name: Domain Admin Sessions
description: Find computers where Domain Admins have active sessions (for credential theft)
cypher: MATCH (u:ADUser)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:ADGroup {name:'DOMAIN ADMINS@{domain}'}), (u)-[:HasSession]->(c:ADComputer) RETURN u.name AS da_user, c.name AS computer, c.operatingsystem AS os ORDER BY c.name

name: Nested Group Membership to DA
description: Enumerate all principals with nested Domain Admin membership
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:ADGroup {name:'DOMAIN ADMINS@{domain}'}) RETURN n.name AS principal, labels(n) AS type ORDER BY labels(n)[0], n.name

name: Cross-Domain Trust Paths
description: Find attack paths that exploit cross-domain trust relationships
cypher: MATCH (d1:ADDomain)-[:TrustedBy|HasTrust]-(d2:ADDomain) RETURN d1.name AS domain1, d2.name AS domain2 ORDER BY d1.name

name: Computers with Local Admin Access
description: Find all computers any owned principal has local admin on
cypher: MATCH (n {owned:true})-[:AdminTo|MemberOf*1..]->(m) WHERE m:ADComputer OR (m:ADGroup)-[:AdminTo]->(:ADComputer) RETURN n.name AS attacker, m.name AS target ORDER BY m.name

name: Owned Principals
description: List all currently owned/compromised principals
cypher: MATCH (n {owned:true}) RETURN n.name AS name, labels(n) AS type, n.description AS description ORDER BY labels(n)[0], n.name

name: LAPS Enabled Computers
description: Find computers with LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution) enabled
cypher: MATCH (c:ADComputer {haslaps:true}) RETURN c.name AS computer, c.operatingsystem AS os, c.lastlogontimestamp AS last_logon ORDER BY c.name

name: Users with Password Never Expires
description: Find enabled users with passwords set to never expire
cypher: MATCH (u:ADUser {pwdneverexpires:true, enabled:true}) WHERE NOT u.name STARTS WITH 'KRBTGT' RETURN u.name AS user, u.displayname AS display_name, u.description AS description, u.pwdlastset AS pwd_last_set ORDER BY u.pwdlastset

name: WriteOwner Permissions
description: Find principals that can change ownership of AD objects
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:WriteOwner]->(m) WHERE n<>m RETURN n.name AS attacker, labels(n) AS attacker_type, m.name AS target, labels(m) AS target_type ORDER BY n.name

name: Shadow Credentials via AddKeyCredentialLink
description: Find principals that can add key credentials (Shadow Credential attack) to other accounts
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:AddKeyCredentialLink]->(m) RETURN n.name AS attacker, labels(n) AS attacker_type, m.name AS victim, labels(m) AS victim_type ORDER BY n.name

name: Privileged Groups Overview
description: Enumerate all privileged built-in AD groups and their direct members
cypher: MATCH (g:ADGroup) WHERE g.name IN ['DOMAIN ADMINS@{domain}','ENTERPRISE ADMINS@{domain}','SCHEMA ADMINS@{domain}','ADMINISTRATORS@{domain}','BACKUP OPERATORS@{domain}','ACCOUNT OPERATORS@{domain}','PRINT OPERATORS@{domain}','SERVER OPERATORS@{domain}'] OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:MemberOf]->(g) RETURN g.name AS group, count(m) AS member_count ORDER BY member_count DESC

name: Protected Users Group Members
description: List members of the Protected Users security group (enhanced Kerberos protection)
cypher: MATCH (u)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:ADGroup {name:'PROTECTED USERS@{domain}'}) RETURN u.name AS user, labels(u) AS type ORDER BY u.name

name: Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD)
description: Find computers with msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity set (RBCD targets)
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:AllowedToAct]->(c:ADComputer) RETURN n.name AS allowed_actor, labels(n) AS actor_type, c.name AS target_computer ORDER BY c.name

name: Computers with Outdated OS
description: Find domain-joined computers running end-of-life operating systems
cypher: MATCH (c:ADComputer) WHERE c.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(XP|Vista|2000|2003|2008|Windows 7|Windows 8[^.]).*' AND c.enabled=true RETURN c.name AS computer, c.operatingsystem AS os, c.lastlogontimestamp AS last_logon ORDER BY c.operatingsystem

name: GenericWrite on Users
description: Find principals with GenericWrite on user objects (can set SPN → Kerberoast or write msDS-KeyCredentialLink → Shadow Creds)
cypher: MATCH (n)-[:GenericWrite]->(m:ADUser) WHERE n<>m RETURN n.name AS attacker, labels(n) AS attacker_type, m.name AS target_user, m.enabled AS enabled ORDER BY n.name
